plan.title: SRC-BID-033 — Technical response read-only after stage end

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its Technical stage after the setup has completed.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Try to change the technical answer and require evidence that the answer is read-only or the edit is refused.
